# Vernfy

> Financial intelligence and risk monitoring. Vernfy tracks spending, budgets and wallets, then
> flags what looks wrong — alerts, insights, anomalies and recurring charges derived from the
> activity as it happens.

The intelligence layer is **rule-based and deterministic**, not machine learning: every alert
comes from a stated threshold that can be read and checked. The one fitted model is the spend
forecast, which is only served after it beats the plain run-rate projection on a holdout backtest.

Vernfy is a single-page app behind sign-in; only the sign-in and registration pages are public.
The source and its documentation are open.

## Product

- [Vernfy](https://vernfy.com/): the app — sign in or create an account
- [Create an account](https://vernfy.com/register): registration

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/Trieu-hub/finsight-platform#readme): what the platform does, how it is built, run and deployed
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Trieu-hub/finsight-platform/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): service boundaries, request and event flow
- [Intelligence](https://github.com/Trieu-hub/finsight-platform/blob/main/docs/intelligence.md): every risk rule, insight and anomaly — its trigger, severity and metric
- [Event catalog](https://github.com/Trieu-hub/finsight-platform/blob/main/docs/event-catalog.md): every Kafka event, its producer and its consumers
